उचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Proper, suitable, convenient.
 2. Receivable, fit
or right to be taken.
 3. Known, understood.
 4. Intrusted, deposited.
5. Measured, adjusted, accurate.
 E. वच् to speak, and कितच् Unādi
aff.

उच्चिकीर्षा f. (-र्षा) Desire or wish to collect.
 E. उत् before चि to collect,
desiderative form, अङ् and टाप् affs.

उच्चिङ्गट m. (-टः)
 1. A sort of cricket.
 2. A passionate man.
 E. उत् like,
and चिङ्गट a shrimp.
